Hello and welcome to a one time only 24 year anniversary of me celebratory session of TALES OF TERRA-NOVA!!!!!!!!!! I am your humble dungeon master and you are my bouncing birthday boys say hi bouncing birthday boys! In our last session, I wasn't 24 years old yet! And in the month of October we have a few birthdays lets hear it for our October boys! Now we may not be continuing our story of the Young Wolves valiant quest against the forces of the Abyss and Arkonil, but we will see some familiar faces today... in the City of Stories. Before we begin I'm going to provide you guys with these (hand them the folders), when dictated by the DM you can open these, so get excited!


##### Set the scene!
[MUSIC](https://youtu.be/wjJ3-SzxhCk?si=hTFpxaJIZRD22SGf)
You all have received a mysterious invitation, to a time and place you don't quite understand, upon opening the letter you feel yourself falling into the star, and awaken in a new world.
In the farthest reaches of space, beyond where the first celestials that became gods were born, past the first stars, beyond everything, there lies a book. A book with pages trillions of miles long and many more tall, with covers of pre-celestial material, made of the trunk of the world tree that all was born from. On the pages of this book exist the things of our world, and those beyond, the Sword Coast where the Deeprock brothers fought for the city of Axeholm, in Waterdeep the friendly faces run the legendary tavern WHOOTERS, on another rests the stories of the Young Wolves, their story still being written, but today we find ourselves on the most legendary and grand page of all. The page that holds the City of Stories, home to creations one and all, stories heard thousands of times and those yet to be written or spoken. The sprawling fantastical city is nigh endless, and its wonders are many, both majestic and untold. In the center of the page lies the Castle of Endless Possibility, where the Coliseum of Heroes stretches high into the stars. 
	As grand and majestic this place is, we find ourselves in many different places, all at once, and yet at many different moments.
	DM NOTE: describe where some characters are as they get pulled into the infinite corridor and when they awaken in the City, head down to intro stuff.


### Intro Stuff
- Roll a d6, 6 is Hannah so reroll on 6, whoever it is counting clockwise is who gets the intro.
- You awaken on the ground in an alley, a few men stand nearby staring at you awkwardly with tankards in their hands and festive face paint and clothes on. As you stand yourself up they giggle and run down the alley into the street, where you can hear music and people singing and laughing.
- You find yourself in fine clothes, a typical dress or shirt you might wear to a party or festival, but all of your equipment is gone.
- The city around them is booming with life, all kinds of people and monsters traveling the cobbled roads, there are lights streamers and all manner of decorations between the buildings, you ae in some kind of fantastical city
- As they struggle to get their bearings, disoriented by their new surroundings, new allies start to show up, first person this happens to is determined by a d6, then the rest go clockwise 
- they gather up in the crowds, and begin to follow the flow of traffic through the streets, if they ask people around them where they are/ what's happening they get told they are in the City of Stories, and its the celebration of the 24th!
- eventually they get grabbed by a tall Lizardfolk man with green and yellow scales, who says he apologizes for the inconvenient travel circumstances, and he's here to take them to the Director of Tournament Participant Affairs and Public Engagement, he brings them to a tower outside what appears to be some kind of coliseum that is thousands of miles tall, where everyone is flooding into
- as the walk up the tower stairs they are led to a large office, floor to ceiling bookshelves and plants everywhere, vines hang from pots and shelves, at the back wall is a large stained glass window and a desk where a man sits in a green knit sweater and smoking a pipe as he rifles through papers and notebooks
- [MUSIC](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vL-LBzf7fYc)
- "AH YES THE CONTESTANTS! At last you have arrived, excited for the festival hmm? Come sit sit," He waves his hand indicating in front of the desk and chairs magically appear in front of him, "Please make yourself at work, not home. It's MY home you see but you can be work comfortable here that's ok. I'm Krieg, game master for the 24th Festival of Daraan."
- He gives them a very vague rundown of the competition, fighting, access to materials and supplies, labor law allotted breaks, without letting them get a word in. If they ask where they are he get surprised they don't know, "Why the city of stories of course... did the gatekeeper not tell you? Gods Barnabus, remind me to talk with the bear, probably asleep again."
- "OWLYSSAAAA, BRING ME THE FORMS PLEASE!" He screams as an Owlin woman brings him a large stack of papers, he pulls the first page off and says, "SIGN HERE now all of you, you have 1 minute, failure to do so will result in permanent temporal erasure by Daraan's angels, you cannot leave unless you compete."
- He nods to Hannah to sit down as another chair magically appears, "Well I suppose now all that's left..." he trails off as he raises his hand, his shadow looming over you as darkness consumes the room, "Is the gifts! Happy Festival of the 24th FRIENDS!"
- He sits there smiling as if something is supposed to be happening. "Oh right, I forgot them. HANNAH BRING ME THE GIFTS FOR THE.... Young WOLVES! That's Young, yes pre calamity. NOW PLEASE!"
- She runs down a hallway and there are sounds of clattering and falling boxes, a cat screams, pots and pans clang together, and she comes sprinting out with a stack of boxes. She places the boxes on the table and the man smiles, stretching his hands out and the boxes each fly into your laps magically.
- Give players their presents. [[Player Presents]] He also hands Ivys two vials of strange blue liquid, "In case you need it!" These are two [[Potion of Divine Favor]]
- As they revel in their new gifts he snaps his fingers, "I have given you express status, within the city of stories you can attune to magical items over the course of 1 action. Enjoy! Oh well its the 24th what the hell, OWLYSSA!!! OWLYSSAAAAAAAAAA Oh you're right next to me. Its a festival hmm darling? Go have some fun with them." He snaps his fingers again and you feel yourself travel at lightspeed as you teleport into the center of a thousands of feet tall coliseum. Around you stand other confused groups of individuals, spread out by more than a hundred feet as you stand within what feels like an endless arena. The stands around you stretch into the stars themselves, and a floating tiny sun orbits above you. 
- [MUSIC](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=plUgICpVAoc): As you try to get your bearings beneath the burning star, a voice echoes out through the arena, silencing the applauding crows. "WELCOMEEEEEE ONE AND ALL, EVERYONE OF EVERYWHERE OF EVERYWHEN? THOSE WHO ARE, HAVE BEEN OR WILL BEEEEEEEEEE! TO THE 24th, THE GREAT CELEBRATION OF CREATION, THE LONG AWAITED, 24TH FESTIVAL OF DARAANNNNNNNNNNNNNN!" The crowd explodes into applause and cheers so loud your ears begin to ring, the sand beneath your feet rumbles from the stomping feet of millions of spectators. As the arena shakes the announcer speaks again, "ALL RIGHT ALL RIGHT LET'S SETTLE DOWN, as of this year we have more contestants than ever before. That's right folks, we won't introduce everyone, because statistically only 5 of them will survive! But I will introduce one very special group, you know em, you love em, Unless you're DAMION SYRELL! AHAHAHAHA" The crowd laughs with him, "That's right folks, special guest stars of this years festival, ITS THE YOUNG WOLVESSSSSSSSSSSSS! Give em a hand yeah there ya go! We'll be keeping a close eye on em during the competition, and maybe we will get an interview with the first and last timekeeper IVYS ARTHUR? Never been able to get a replicant here before, Kairos must not like to PARTYYYYYYYYYY!"
- "They're looking at us like we're crazy folks, let's cut em some slack, and explain the competition!" [[Festival Rules]]

### THE PILLAR
[MUSIC](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3YO67uD8TAo)
- The pillar is covered in equipment, all kinds of basic equipment. As an action you can take any item on the [weapons](https://dnd5e.wikidot.com/weapons) or [armor and shields](https://dnd5e.wikidot.com/armor) tables from wikidot.
- The first two people to loot do so but enemies are closing fast. As they loot, they feel a gust of wind, your combat instincts kicking in at the last possible second as you duck, a fist flying past where the back of your head would have been and cracking the pillar above you. As you look up at your attacker you see the visage of Thergar, the pale metal armed bugbear you fought in the Greenpeak mountains so long ago!
- He laughs and tries to attack you again as a pair of goblins jump into the fray alongside him. ROLL INITIATIVE! 
	- **Enemies:** [[thergar.png]], 2x [[goblin.png]]

### CUT BACK FROM MAZE

You find yourselves on this massive marble platform, other groups around you more than 80ft away on 4 spots equidistant from each other. In the center the floating crystal of the announcer, projecting his voice to the masses. Everyone cheers as you arrive back from your trials, overjoyed with your effort!

"THANK YOU SO MUCH HEROES FOR THAT AMAZING SPECTACLE! A SPECIAL THANKS TO IVAR AND TYRAN, A WONDERFUL PAIR WHO TOOK DOWN A RECREATION OF THE EVIL VORACIA, AND TO THE YOUNG WOLVES FOR DOING BATTLE WITH THE SOLAR DRAGON BASARYM!"

"Now the maze may be concluded for today, but our festivities are not over, Our Lord Daraan has asked us to conduct a special AWARD CEREMONY before seeing which group collected 24 shards, so lets go!"

The platform shoots up into the sky, launching you with it into the stars at an alarming rate, the arena erupting with applause as you rise into the sky.

Before you hovers an eldritch being, tentacled hair, black scaled body, millions of eyes, curled up into a ball, a single massive eye gazing at you, glowing red yellow and orange.
"To Hunter, Grey, and Audrey, for having hands in the most stories in Terra-Nova of your merry band, a shard for you three." +1 shard.
"To Grey, for the most characters in Terra-Nova, a shard for your great contribution to this world and its histories." +1 shard.
"And finally, to Hannah, for being the most wonderful girlfriend in the world, listening to me ramble about this game all the time, and for helping me organize this amazing day, thank you." +1 shard.

24 SHARDS OBTAINED!
